entries.title: Growing Tree Root Network in Soil Layers
entries.description: A central tree trunk spawns branching roots that slowly grow, split, and curve through semi-transparent colored soil layers, avoiding dense rock spheres and wrapping around nutrient pellets that glow and transfer color along the root network.

entries.title: Competing Root Systems in a Shared Planter Box
